name: Bifrost Rust CodeQL quality
description: Public Rust quality policies aligned with reviewed CodeQL query identities and supported engine facts.

policies.severity_rationale: Reading or writing through a pointer to a stack place that has gone out of scope is undefined behavior and can expose or corrupt unrelated stack data.
policies.remediation: Return an owned value or a reference with a lifetime bound to its owner, or keep the owning local alive until the last access through the pointer.

policies.severity_rationale: Reading or writing through a raw pointer after its allocation was released is undefined behavior and can read freed memory or corrupt the allocator.
policies.remediation: Access the allocation only before it is released, or stop using the pointer after the release and re-derive it from a live owner.

policies.severity_rationale: A constructor that reaches standard-library behavior can perform surprising work during initialization before normal application startup.
policies.remediation: Keep constructors limited to simple state setup and move I/O or other standard-library operations into explicit startup code.

policies.severity_rationale: A value written to a local that nothing reads may indicate stale code or a missed use of the value.
policies.remediation: Use the value as intended, or remove the write after checking that its right-hand side has no side effects the program needs.

policies.severity_rationale: An unused binding may indicate incomplete code or a typo in a name that should have been used.
policies.remediation: Use the binding as intended, or remove it, or prefix its name with an underscore when it is deliberately unused.
